entities.summary: José Rojas Rojas Jr. is a Filipino bishop of the Roman Catholic Church who has served as the first diocesan bishop of Libmanan since 2009. He previously served as territorial prelate of the then-Prelature of Libmanan from 2008 until its elevation to a full-fledged diocese in 2009.
